handoff_dependencies: coordinator handoff for the newly saved alert, its current material and its fixed A Run
restricted saved-source and E28/E31 evidence linked to that same alert and material
8181_navigation: search the current alert list by the single handed-off alert ID
open the matching list sidebar and check its AI conclusion
open alert overview from the sidebar and compare with the saved handoff
refresh the same alert overview once and repeat the same identity and display checks

readback_checks.binding: Same alert, current material, E28 locator, E31 metadata and published A Run.
readback_checks.rule: Normalized rule name and ID match the saved first-receive material and the corresponding fields in the bound OCSF original.
readback_checks.source_confidence: Show the OCSF confidence level and native score as available on the bound material.
readback_checks.fusion: Validate the finite saved Fusion value, unit and state against the first-receive snapshot. Record the actual state and unresolved numeric coverage if the value is absent.
readback_checks.ai: Match the same-round saved AI conclusion and finite score or explicit not_computed null. Check the saved rationale and display of the unscored reason when applicable.
readback_checks.sidebar: The AI row shows the conclusion alone for the same alert.
readback_checks.connectivity: Check for material and investigation service read errors on the sidebar and overview before and after refresh.

evidence.public: Field structure, boolean results, restricted receipt paths and source fingerprints.
evidence.private: Business values, original bodies and any browser screenshots remain in the restricted environment.
evidence.blocked: Record the failed layer and stop at this readback.
